en.title: The Cherry-Colored Wind and the Adventure of the Secret Map
en.premise: One day, a little squirrel named Popo discovers a "secret map" hidden inside an old tree. The map reveals the location of the magical "Cherry Blossom Sakura," a legendary bloom said to dye the entire world in shades of pink. Alongside Luna, a timid little rabbit, Popo sets off on an adventure guided by the map. This journey following the faded trails will surely become a wonderful gift, teaching them the true meaning of courage and kindness.

zh.title: 樱桃色的风与秘密地图的冒险
zh.premise: 小松鼠波波某天在古树中发现了一张“秘密地图”。地图上描绘着传说中能将整个世界染成粉红色的魔法“樱桃樱”所在之处。波波决定带着胆小的兔子露娜，依靠地图踏上冒险之旅。追寻着这张褪色地图的旅程，定会成为一份教会人们勇气与温柔的美好礼物。
